auth.password_hint: 10 or more characters. A few words in a row work well. Common passwords, and ones made from your name or email address, are refused.

errors.password_short: Password must be at least 8 characters
errors.password_min: Password must be at least 10 characters

login.headline: Sign in to FixFlow
login.subtitle: Enter your credentials to continue
login.code_help: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app. If you have lost your phone, enter one of your recovery codes instead.
login.need_account: Need an account? Ask your administrator to invite you.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.cannot_send: This server cannot send email, so it cannot send you a link. Ask your administrator for a password reset link; they can create one from Settings, Users.
forgot.intro: Enter the email you sign in with and we will send you a link to choose a new password.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.missing_code: This link is missing its reset code.

invite.invalid_body: The link is invalid, was already used, or has expired. Ask your administrator to send a new one.
invite.welcome: Hi {{name}}, choose a password to finish setting up your {{role}} account.

setup.title: Set up FixFlow
setup.intro: Create your company and the first administrator. You can invite everyone else afterwards.

two_factor.title: Set up two-factor sign-in
two_factor.intro: Your company requires it. It takes a minute, and you need your phone.

toast.password_set_failed: Could not set your password. Try again.
toast.request_failed: Could not send the request. Try again in a moment.
toast.code_failed: Could not check the code. Try again.
